decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Reasonable
Exemption Statement, Site Location Plan, 725/25/01, 725/25/02, 725/25/03 (received 09/09/2025), 725/25/04
(received 09/09/2025)
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Conversionof garage to habitable room, Replace garage door with window in front elevation, Twostorey side extension, Single and two storey rear extension (Demolition of side to rearextension, and rear conservatory)
